# MedLegal AI Hero

> Free, practical, MIT-licensed AI skills for physicians doing medical-legal work, from Tresa. Each skill runs in the physician's own AI tool; no case material is sent to us.

## Pages

- [Home](https://qmeaihero.com/): what the project is
- [Start Here](https://qmeaihero.com/start-here.html): a guide to setting up AI for medical-legal work, PHI safeguards, and trying a first skill on a fictional case
- [Skills](https://qmeaihero.com/skills.html): the published skills
- [/case-facts](https://qmeaihero.com/case-facts.html): compare identifying and administrative facts across case documents and surface conflicts with source evidence

## Machine-readable

- [skills.md](https://qmeaihero.com/skills.md): one entry per skill with install path
- [sitemap.md](https://qmeaihero.com/sitemap.md)
- [rss.xml](https://qmeaihero.com/rss.xml)
